payload.entry: force_parser done. New src/native/highlights_ref/force.rs: ForceMode::{Reread,Overwrite}, spec'd clap arg (num_args 0..=1, require_equals, default_missing reread, possible values, ignore_case), after-only adoption via clap indices with bareness read from raw argv (bare and --force= are index-identical in clap 4.6.7: flag slot + one value slot), stray-mode guard (exact or edit distance <=2, escapes ./x [[x] existing-path URL), missing-target re-parse for byte-identical usage error. Option<ForceMode> through CreateOptions/ClipOptions/collection; low-level bool perms via is_some(); unrelated commands' force flags untouched. Overwrite triage: filed refs exit 2 '-f overwrite is not available yet for filed references'; fresh sources exit 1 'nothing to overwrite: <source> is not a reference yet' + hint; queued-only/exact-output/audio keep old perms; -L attach preserved. Help: -f row + Recapture section (honest interim limits); completion automatic via clap choices (group mode, !prefix 8). Verified: 14 force unit tests (full matrix), 13 new CLI tests (guard/adoption/missing-target/repeat/invalid/fresh/filed/queued/clip-alias/glued/collection + no-fetch no-adapter no-write proofs), full highlights lib 751 + CLI 399 + completion/help/docs 146 + ref_library/aliases 185 all green; cargo fmt clean; clippy gate 0 errors; just docs-gen + docs-check pass (ref.md golden unchanged: member help not captured). Deviation from matrix: '-foverwrite URL' is NOT clap UnknownArgument — '-o' owns short o so it parses as '-f -o verwrite' and fails on the output-path extension (verified byte-identical to spaced form); help documents this and a test locks it.

Epic symbols: none for bob-cli-c9.3.1 or bob-cli-c9.3. Code review found remaining epic work (regressions and unmet plan items), planned as a child epic: title-route stem probe ignores title identity (different-title stems refuse/reread instead of _2; -N remedy lost); locked intake recheck refuses every audio attach onto a __vN or natural protocol__v2 reference; multi-family URL overlap returns Ambiguous so -N can reread a partially overlapping family; collection -L attach treats readings as separate groups and single-source -L attaches to the oldest reading; deleted-root families mint <root>__v2__vN; filed refusal drops reading numbers; exact-output replacement lost under -f overwrite on URL/collection routes; plain reread prints no narrated-reading hint; -f -L -P on a library PDF attaches; vault-note preflight runs after parent resolution; post-fetch guard ignores redirect final_url; parser raw-argv misses bob ref -n create and -df=MODE; rereads still auto-discover Markdown audio; docs/help gaps; stale dead_code allows. FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: (1) bob-cli-c9.3.1.3 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP (full-scan raw intake moves lack the locked reread recheck) - ABSORBED into the remaining epic work, not filed as a task: the epic's acceptance requires queued reread + scan to file nothing over an occupant, and create -f queues __vN PDFs that a full bob ref scan moves through doctor.rs plan_xlib_intake without the whole-bundle recheck. No other PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries exist on any child. Reviewer-noted items deliberately NOT filed: per-create library+task index build (by design: the plan requires resolving hits through the library index); whole-bundle checks for ordinary (non-__vN) full-scan moves and redirect-aware dedupe for ordinary captures (pre-existing, race-only/no reported harm, outside this epic's contract); URL reread dry runs still fetch (matches the documented URL dry-run contract in docs/highlights-create.md; the reread decision and line are computed before fetch); -f overwrite -L on a filed reference keeps the old companion-audio attach permission (plan keeps audio replacement permissions under either mode).
